title: fadebox catalog entry
description: <entry>/template.yaml: the payload an import copies into an editable fadebox template. Fadebox reads it when the entry is opened and again on import; the spec is parsed by the same Compose parser the template editor uses.

slug.description: The same slug as the index row. It becomes the imported template's identifier unless the importer chooses another.

name.description: The imported template's display name, unless the importer chooses another.

version.description: The same version as the index row; recorded on the imported template.

spec.description: A Docker Compose document as a YAML block scalar: exactly one main service plus helpers labelled fadebox.role: init or fadebox.role: sidecar. The Compose subset is static and strict — an unsupported key is refused on import. See https://fadebox.io/docs/guides/template-authoring.

files.description: Files injected into a container at deploy time — an init script, a config file.

serviceKey.description: The service in spec the file is injected into.

targetPath.description: Absolute path inside the container. It must not sit inside one of that service's volume mounts, where the mount would shadow it.

content.description: The file's text, at most 1 MiB.
